issues.description: The Note.creationDate field has inconsistent types between repositories and within the solution: the template's common model defines creationDate as java.time.Instant, while the solution's common model defines creationDate as String. Worse, the solution's server-side NoteService still calls note.setCreationDate(Instant.now()), which does not match the solution common model's String type. This inconsistency will prevent the solution from compiling and will confuse students comparing template, problem text, and solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the creationDate type consistent across client, common, and server. Either: (A) revert the solution common Note.creationDate to java.time.Instant to match NoteService and the template, or (B) change NoteService to set a String (e.g. note.setCreationDate(Instant.now().toString())) and ensure serialization/deserialization works for the client and server. Prefer keeping creationDate as Instant in the common model (option A) for type-safety, updating any JSON (de)serialization if necessary.
